# Exit Codes

<!-- GENERATED by `jit::schema::render_exit_code_reference` (`crates/jit/src/schema.rs`). Do not edit by hand; regenerate instead. -->

`jit` returns a small, stable set of process exit codes so scripts and agents can branch on outcomes without parsing output. This page is projected from the exit-code taxonomy and the command mappings in `jit --schema`. Each emitted mapping is bound by a test to the runtime that produces it: the shared classifier (`classify` in `crates/jit/src/output/failure.rs`) for codes raised as typed errors, and the command's own `std::process::exit` site for codes a completed run emits directly (the findings signals).

## Global taxonomy

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `0` | Command succeeded |
| `1` | Generic error occurred |
| `2` | Invalid arguments or usage error |
| `3` | Resource not found (issue, gate, etc.) |
| `4` | Validation failed (cycle detected, broken references, etc.) |
| `5` | Permission denied |
| `6` | Resource already exists |
| `10` | External dependency failed (git, file system, etc.) |
| `11` | A lock wait expired while another jit process held the lock; retrying may succeed |
| `141` | Downstream reader closed the pipe while jit was writing (128 + SIGPIPE) |

## Command-specific mappings

Most commands draw only from the global taxonomy above. The rows below identify the codes a specific command family emits. An **exception** is a code a completed run emits to signal findings, or a code whose meaning departs from the global entry (for example, `doc check-links` exits `4` for broken links, not a generic error). `*` marks a code every command can reach: `0` on successful completion, and the failure codes through the shared classifier.

| Command | Code | Condition | Exception |
|---------|------|-----------|-----------|
| `worktree info, worktree list` | `3` | A required filesystem path was not found. |  |
| `worktree info, worktree list` | `5` | A filesystem operation was denied. |  |
| `worktree info, worktree list` | `10` | An I/O failure prevented worktree inspection. |  |
| `worktree store-divergence` | `5` | A filesystem operation reading the primary checkout's store was denied. |  |
| `*` | `0` | Command completed successfully. |  |
| `*` | `1` | No typed classifier matched the failure (generic error). |  |
| `*` | `2` | Invalid arguments or usage error, including an unresolvable, ambiguous, or too-short id prefix. |  |
| `*` | `3` | A referenced issue, gate, gate-run, preset, lease, repository, or file path was not found. |  |
| `*` | `5` | A filesystem operation was denied. |  |
| `profile apply` | `2` | The --values-file path could not be read. |  |
| `profile apply` | `4` | Repository-state derivation refused conflicting profile targets. |  |
| `profile diff` | `4` | The difference report found targets or final validation that prevent publication. | yes |
| `profile pack` | `6` | The archive output path already exists. |  |
| `profile add` | `4` | The package destination already exists. |  |
| `*` | `10` | The repository's on-disk format is not the one this binary accepts, or a filesystem/subprocess I/O operation failed. |  |
| `*` | `11` | A lock wait expired while another jit process held the lock (`JIT_LOCK_TIMEOUT`); the command changed nothing and may be retried. |  |
| `search` | `1` | ripgrep is not installed (RIPGREP_NOT_FOUND) or ran and failed (SEARCH_FAILED). |  |
| `search` | `10` | ripgrep could not be spawned or the search root could not be resolved (I/O failure). |  |
| `any command that writes an issue` | `4` | An enforcing validation rule rejected the write (the shared write-validation path blocks on rule findings). |  |
| `dep add` | `4` | The edge would create a cycle (CYCLE_DETECTED), or a redundant (transitively-implied) edge was rejected (VALIDATION_FAILED), in human and JSON output alike. |  |
| `apply` | `4` | The template delta would close a dependency cycle through existing issues; the apply is rejected before any node is created. |  |
| `init` | `2` | The `--values-file` path cannot be read. |  |
| `issue update, issue claim, issue claim-next` | `4` | A state transition is blocked by unmet dependencies or unpassed gates. |  |
| `gate define, gate update, gate remove, gate add, gate list, gate show, gate preset list, gate preset show, gate preset create` | `1` | A registry or preset file could not be parsed, or an untyped command failure occurred. Other typed failures use the universal codes. |  |
| `gate define` | `6` | The gate key is already registered. |  |
| `issue delete` | `2` | Deletion was refused for missing operator confirmation (JIT_ALLOW_DELETION=1 not set in the process environment). |  |
| `issue batch-create` | `2` | The batch file failed pre-validation; no issues were created. |  |
| `snapshot export` | `6` | The snapshot output path already exists. |  |
| `claim` | `10` | A lease subcommand was run outside a git repository (leases require git for worktree identity). |  |
| `hooks install` | `2` | The invocation is outside a git repository. |  |
| `hooks install` | `3` | A repository path needed to install hooks was not found. |  |
| `hooks install` | `5` | Filesystem permissions denied hook installation. |  |
| `hooks install` | `10` | A filesystem or subprocess operation needed to install hooks failed. |  |
| `gate evaluate, gate evaluate-all, gate evaluate-many` | `4` | A checker ran and its verdict was fail. | yes |
| `gate evaluate, gate evaluate-all, gate evaluate-many` | `10` | A checker could not run to a verdict (timeout, crash, command not found, or exit status 75). | yes |
| `validate` | `4` | Repository, scope, issue, selected-rule, or explanation validation reported error-severity findings. | yes |
| `validate --branch-drift` | `4` | Branch-drift validation failed: the check reported drift from the upstream branch or could not run. | yes |
| `validate --leases` | `4` | Lease validation found one or more invalid leases, or the lease check could not run. | yes |
| `gate status-all` | `4` | One or more required gates have not passed. | yes |
| `invariant check` | `4` | Enforcement drift was found (declared enforcement not backed by an enforcing rule). | yes |
| `item list, item search, item show, item resolve` | `2` | The repository configuration failed to load, or an item address was not a qualified id. |  |
| `config validate` | `4` | The repo or environment-variable configuration failed to load or carried an invalid value. |  |
| `doc check-links` | `4` | One or more documents have broken links. Documents with only risky-link warnings exit `0`: warnings are reported, never fatal. | yes |
| `gate preset apply` | `3` | One or more preset targets failed; the findings report retains successful targets and per-target errors. | yes |
| `project render` | `2` | The requested projection name is not declared in repository configuration. |  |
| `serve, serve --stop, serve --status` | `1` | The daemon PID state could not be parsed (exits 0 on success). |  |
| `*` | `141` | A downstream reader closed the pipe while jit was still writing. | yes |
| `serve --fg` | `1` | The foreground server exited with a failure status (`SERVER_EXITED`; the child's status is in `error.details`). |  |

For the full `jit gate evaluate` verdict taxonomy and the `--json` `verdict` field, see [the gate command reference](cli-commands.md).
